**Please check the brief first**
PXF is built to the specification in [docs/SPEC.md](../../docs/SPEC.md). The 20-preset cap,
the absence of user preset saving and the fixed window size are deliberate. Requests that
change those need to argue the case.

**What you want**
The behaviour you are missing.

**Why**
What you are trying to do that PXF makes hard today.

**What it would replace or affect**
PXF stays small on purpose. If this goes in, what stays out?
